task.ques: Explore accessories for Apple Vision Pro, list at least three accessories.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Three accessories for Apple Vision Pro listed by Apple:

- Apple Vision Pro Travel Case — $199.00.
- Apple Vision Pro Battery — $199.00.

Source: Apple’s US Apple Vision Pro Essentials page, viewed October 27, 2026: https://www.apple.com/shop/vision/accessories/apple-vision-pro-essentials
Evidence: final.png is a 1280 × 723 viewport screenshot showing these three accessories and their listed prices together, with Featured sorting visible.
